ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible surface. High-intensity (white) pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips and in discrete circular formations, creating extreme local contrast against the black substrate.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid black pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity white geometric clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips. Several high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) are positioned along the horizontal mid-lines of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow acute angle and high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary. The left lobe exhibits three major semi-circular indentations. The right lobe shows a jagged, 'stepped' profile with high pixel-amplitude peaks and a significant triangular section of missing tissue.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve that tapers into elongated, slightly recurved and pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of seven distinct circular high-contrast white rings. Four are distributed along the left lobe's longitudinal axis; two are closely paired in the center-right lobe; one is positioned near the median notch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe creating a jagged, non-linear profile. Dense, textured, high-intensity white clusters (calcified epibionts) present at the distal tips of both lobes.
